229: // obtainCert obtains a certificate for given domain, use cached manager if cert exists there.
230: func (mgr *Manager) obtainCert(ctx context.Context, domain string, cm *certmagic.Config) (certmagic.Certificate, error) {
231: 	cert, err := cm.CacheManagedCertificate(domain)
232: 	if err != nil {
233: 		log.Info(ctx).Str("domain", domain).Msg("obtaining certificate")
234: 		err = cm.ObtainCertSync(ctx, domain)
235: 		if err != nil {
236: 			log.Error(ctx).Err(err).Msg("autocert failed to obtain client certificate")
237: 			return certmagic.Certificate{}, errObtainCertFailed
238: 		}
239: 		metrics.RecordAutocertRenewal()
240: 		cert, err = cm.CacheManagedCertificate(domain)
241: 	}
242: 	return cert, err
243: }

246: func (mgr *Manager) renewCert(ctx context.Context, domain string, cert certmagic.Certificate, cm *certmagic.Config) (certmagic.Certificate, error) {
247: 	expired := time.Now().After(cert.Leaf.NotAfter)
248: 	log.Info(ctx).Str("domain", domain).Msg("renewing certificate")
249: 	renewCertLock.Lock()
